acceptanceCriteria: At --limit 10 on this case, the multi-term code symbols rank above single-term feature records, or the packet explains why they were omitted.
The Beamfall goldens and retrieval bench are rerun, with before and after numbers recorded.
body: Filed 2026-09-25 from the V1-0260 diagnosis (PR #189). On Beamfall at 0d7796be, the trust-root task and three rewordings return packets full of plugin feature records that each match only the word `plugin` (score 705) at --limit 10, and `internal/plugin/trust.go` never appears, even though `PluginTrustRoots` matches 8 query terms and `NewModelLoader` 11. The GPK-V0-066 fix only applies when the whole record packet fails the floor, which happens at limits 1 and 3, not at 10.
title: query: at limit 10, single-word plugin feature records still crowd the matching code symbols out of the packet
